## Listing thumbnails and titles

The demo catalog shows 151 real listings from public asset stores. Their thumbnails (`frontend/public/thumbs`, downsized copies of each listing's own image) and their titles are third-party material owned by their respective creators and stores. They are bundled only to demonstrate the product, they are **not** covered by this repository's license, and every asset page links back to the original listing.

To request the removal of a listing or thumbnail, contact [it@labmgm.org](mailto:it@labmgm.org).

## Fonts

The latin subsets of these variable fonts are self-hosted in `frontend/src/styles/fonts` (obtained from Google Fonts) and are licensed under the [SIL Open Font License 1.1](https://openfontlicense.org):

- Bricolage Grotesque, Copyright The Bricolage Grotesque Project Authors (<https://github.com/ateliertriay/bricolage>)
- Geist and Geist Mono, Copyright Vercel, in collaboration with basement.studio (<https://github.com/vercel/geist-font>)
